# Aaradhya Dev Tamrakar (ADT)

> Aaradhya Dev Tamrakar (ADT) is an Electronics, Communication & Information Engineering student (BEI IV/I) at Kathmandu Engineering College (IOE, Tribhuvan University). He is a Fuse AI Fellow (Fusemachines 2026), NSSR DataCamp Fellow (Cohort 2), and Vice Chair of the IEEE KEC KTM Student Branch, specializing in embedded systems, robotics, Edge AI (ESP32-S3 / MPU6050), machine learning, and full-stack software development.

- [Experience](https://aaradhyadt.github.io/experience.html): Professional fellowships (Fuse AI Fellow, NSSR DataCamp Fellow) and leadership history (IEEE KEC KTM Vice Chair, EPC Event Manager).

## Key Projects

- **SPARK**: Two-layer, fully on-device fall-detection wearable for eldercare featuring an ESP32-S3 microcontroller, MPU6050 IMU, TFLite Micro CNN inference, and a Raspberry Pi 4B gateway with SHAP explainability.
- **BiasAperture**: Vision-model fairness and demographic disparity diagnostic suite (Fuse AI Fellowship capstone).
- **Text-to-SQL Agentic Pipeline**: Five-stage agentic Text-to-SQL generation pipeline with 100% benchmark execution accuracy.
